actions.action: Check soil moisture by feeling it
If soil is wet, leave plant to dry out and water only when top two inches are dry
If soil is bone dry, increase watering frequency, watering when top two inches feel dry
Move plant gradually closer to a window for more light
Snip off old wilted leaves with clean secateurs
Repot into a larger pot/nursery pouch with fresh compost
Keep plant in a room with warm, even temperature
Contact plant doctors if no improvement after a week

verdict.reason: The generic article lists underwatering as just one of six causes and puts overwatering first, so both diagnosis and advice are only partial; it is not harmful, because checking the soil safeguards the watering advice, though it never says to water the dry plant right away.
